exposure: Unexplained ST vs. ST with known cause
Persistent sinus tachycardia (ST) during peripartum period
finding: Pregnant women with persistent sinus tachycardia, particularly unexplained ST, had significantly higher rates of cesarean section and longer length of stay.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with persistent sinus tachycardia, particularly unexplained ST, had significantly higher rates of cesarean section.
